messages:
Aisha: Heads-up: planning to finalize release notes and internal announcement for Optimize v1.4 on 2026-03-25. Need copy locks + embargo timing. Can we get copy + FAQ bullets by EOD?

Connor: I can draft the customer-facing 1-liner. Keep it <120 chars. Also want two variants: technical and marketing.

Nora: Ops: when will the canary run be scheduled? We need the synthetic test matrix and a staging smoke before canary. Prefer canary 30m before the window.

Sam: proposed timeline: canary 2026-03-25T16:30:00Z (30m), full rollout 2026-03-25T17:00:00Z. Manual trigger only. Rollback window: 20m after canary.

deploy-bot: Job scheduled 7050030000%? Scheduled job created release-opt-v1.4.0: canary at 2026-03-25T16:30:00Z, ramp to 50% at 16:50Z, full at 17:00Z. Trigger: manual_confirm. rollback-cmd: `bin/release rollback v1.4.0`. health-check: 5m gating at each stage.

Lili: QA: staging smoke green. PR with tests: https://gh.redwood/repo/pull/4388. I added a short synthetic that hits the batching fast path.

Connor: Draft customer one-liners:
- Marketing: `Redwood Optimize v1.4 cuts inference costs up to 40% for chat workloads with smarter batching.`
- Tech: `Optimize v1.4: improved batching + KV cache reuse => up to 40% cost reduction for long chats.`
Which should we use?

Aisha: use Marketing for external push, Tech for release notes page. Internal announcement should include one-paragraph + 3 bullets (what changed, impact, what to watch).

Connor: internal paragraph draft: `Rolling out Optimize v1.4 (server-side only): reduces typical per-token cost by up to 40% via smarter request batching and KV cache reuse. No model changes. Monitor latency-sensitive endpoints during the window.`

Nora: Ops checklist (condensed): staging smoke -> canary at 16:30 -> 5m health gate -> 50% for 10m -> full roll if green. Metrics to watch: p95 latency, error-rate, token throughput, deploy pipeline error logs. Rollback criteria: increase in 5m error rate >1.5% absolute OR p95 +60ms vs baseline for 5m.

Sam: add one more gating rule: if mem pressure on GPU hosts increases >10% vs baseline, abort. We saw this before with a different quant path.

Lili: localization note: will queue localized snippets (en, de, fr, ja). Legal asked for a micro-disclaimer: `No model changes were made; this is a serving-layer improvement.` Can we include that in the internal + external copy?

Aisha: yes include the legal line in the release notes page but not in the short blast. Locale deadlines: please deliver localized text by 15:45Z.

Connor: I'll produce a 1-line for blast and a longer note for the release page. Posting both here in 30m.

deploy-bot: Reminder: please confirm `manual_confirm` by 2026-03-25T16:20:00Z to avoid auto-cancel.

Nora: reminder to oncall: @Sam will own the canary, @Nora will own rollback execution. If rollback triggered, also ping #incidents and #customer-ops with short status.

Aisha: communications plan: internal announce to #general 30m after full rollout if green; customer email only after 24h if metrics stable. Jordan from comms unavailable, Connor will hand off to marketing for the external blast.

Sam: last check: who is approves the release notes final copy? Aisha: you?

Aisha: I will sign off once localized snippets and QA link are posted. Locking copy 15:55Z if all green. :lock:
